component.name: Pickit
component.summary: Create desktop widgets by describing them

description.p: Describe a widget in plain language, such as a clock, system meters, weather or a now-playing panel. Pickit uses Claude to build it and pins it to your desktop.

ul.li: Widgets sit on the desktop below your windows, on every workspace
They stay after you close the app and come back after a reboot
Refine any widget by asking for changes, such as "make it bigger and blue"
Live data comes from shell commands that you review and approve first
Works with your Claude Code login or an Anthropic API key

screenshot.caption: Editing a widget with a live preview

ul.li: Widgets no longer appear in docks such as Plank
Only one widget daemon runs at a time, so widgets are never drawn twice
Signed Flatpak repository: install and update from any software center
